meta.title: SAFEHOUSE: Operation Canopy Grid
meta.tagline: Uncover the hidden signal mapping Wayanad's ancient soil.
meta.fiction_notice: All companies, villains, agencies, and operational incidents in this game are entirely fictional. Real heritage sites, myths, and systemic issues are used purely for educational and cultural context. No real entity is accused of wrongdoing.

handler.voice_brief: Direct, calm, precise Malayalam-English code-switcher. Deeply committed to regional preservation and data privacy.

antagonist.name: AETHEL BIO-SYNTHETICS
antagonist.symbol_desc: Stylized obsidian triangle overlapping a double helix framed by three botanical leaves.
antagonist.front_org: Western Ghats Soil & Agronomic Research Foundation (WGSARF)

chapters.title: The Battery Cipher
chapters.briefing: Operative, welcome to Sulthan Bathery. WGSARF scouts were spotted scanning the heritage perimeter. Intercept their transmission by accessing Relay Node 01 near the temple road.

myth.text: The Jain temple, built in the 13th century, was later repurposed by Tipu Sultan as his military battery, giving the town its current name.
myth.source: Archaeological Survey of India / District Gazette

tasks.prompt: Proceed to the private spice shop opposite the Jain Temple entrance gate.
Count the vertical carved granite pillars on the outer temple entrance portico. Enter the count multiplied by 101 as the node password.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Intercepted shipping manifest confirming AETHEL micro-transceivers imported under 'soil moisture sensors'.

node.disguise: Hollow teakwood elephant sculpture on display shelf
node.puzzle: What year was Tipu Sultan's battery established in Kidanganad?

safety_notes: Stay on public footpaths along the main road.
Do not enter restricted temple structural zones after sunset.
Watch for heavy town traffic when crossing roads.

chapters.title: The Echoes of Ambukuthi
chapters.briefing: WGSARF field teams are comparing modern micro-scans against ancient petroglyph patterns. We need to reach Node 02 at the base cafe before they complete their upload.

myth.text: Folklore states the cave fissures on Ambukuthi Mala were created by arrows shot by Lava and Kusha, sons of Lord Rama.

tasks.prompt: Approach within 15 meters of the Eco-Homestay Cafe reception desk at the Edakkal base access trail.
Locate the carved wooden symbol on the cafe's heritage board. Match it with the pre-historic animal petroglyph ID.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Encrypted audio files detailing illegal soil sampling across private rubber and coffee holdings.

node.disguise: Vintage brass wall barometer mounted near reception counter
node.puzzle: Enter the number of human figures depicted on the primary petroglyph replica.

safety_notes: Steep uphill walking path; wear shoes with adequate grip.
Slippery stone surfaces during monsoon rains.
Do not leave designated commercial pathways.

chapters.title: The Granite Ledger
chapters.briefing: Hero stones commemorate ancient defenders. Modern defenders need data. Connect to Node 03 located at the Organic Farmer Co-op office in Ambalavayal.

myth.text: Veerakal (Hero Stones) were raised in medieval Kerala to honor leaders who gave their lives protecting local livestock and land from invaders.

tasks.prompt: Check in at the Ambalavayal Farmer Co-op front desk.
Find the year the local agricultural co-op was founded on the entrance plaque. Subtract 1900 to form the 2-digit unlock key.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Target list of heirloom rice varieties targeted by AETHEL biopiracy units.

node.disguise: IP67 electrical junction box behind solar panel display unit
node.puzzle: What is the primary heirloom rice variety preserved in Ambalavayal?

safety_notes: Standard town walking area; abide by urban pedestrian safety rules.
Do not interfere with co-op business operations.

chapters.title: The Monolith Relay
chapters.briefing: AETHEL is using high-altitude points to relay stolen data packets. Intercept Node 04 located at the Kolagappara base homestay gazebo.

myth.text: Historical oral legends describe Kolagappara as a signal post where smoke and fire signals warned regional chieftains of incoming forces.
myth.source: Local oral tradition; requires local field verification

tasks.prompt: Stand within 10 meters of the homestay gazebo lookout point.
Locate the compass bearing etched onto the wooden railing table pointing toward Cheengeri Mala. Enter the angle in degrees.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Radio frequency matrix used by WGSARF long-range mesh nodes.

node.disguise: Weatherproof wooden birdhouse mounted on a gazebo post
node.puzzle: Name the monolithic rock visible along the 140-degree line of sight.

safety_notes: Private property access only with host permission.
Do not attempt to climb steep rock faces or cliff edges.
Remain strictly within fenced gazebo perimeters.

chapters.title: The Exile Protocol
chapters.briefing: AETHEL is attempting to synthesize synthetic patents using soil runoff signatures. Connect to Node 05 inside the plant nursery to wipe their remote backups.

myth.text: Local lore links Pulpally to the Valmiki Ashram where Sita stayed during her exile, with local springs formed by her tears.

tasks.prompt: Visit the private plant nursery counter in Pulpally.
Find the nursery's official soil classification tag number on the demonstration garden bed.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Full genetic sequencing payload prepared by AETHEL for international bio-patent submission.

node.disguise: Drip-irrigation timer enclosure on nursery wall
node.puzzle: What is the local river name associated with the legend of Sita's exile in Pulpally?

safety_notes: Watch out for wet greenhouse floors and garden hoses.
Do not disturb plant nursery stocks or private nursery property.

chapters.title: The Chieftain's Legacy
chapters.briefing: FINAL OPERATION. Join the scheduled guided group trek along the Lakkidi estate boundary. Access Node 06 to extract the master dossier.

myth.text: Karinthandan, chieftain of the Paniya tribe, guided the British through the Thamarassery Pass, but was killed so foreign engineers could claim credit.
myth.source: Kerala District Gazetteers & Local Historical Memorials

tasks.prompt: Present event confirmation to the SAFEHOUSE certified guide at Lakkidi Estate base.
Locate the brass commemoration year plate on the private estate lounge wall. Enter the last two digits.

chapters.intel_unlocked: Master Dossier: Complete proof of AETHEL's illegal biopiracy and climate data expropriation grid.

node.disguise: Restored 1940s tabletop valve radio chassis on lounge shelf
node.puzzle: What iron artifact binds the legendary spirit at Lakkidi Pass?

safety_notes: MANDATORY: Must be conducted as a daytime guided event with a certified trail lead.
Stay strictly on marked private estate walking paths.
Extreme caution near steep mountain pass perimeters; no night play.

ending.choice_a: Leak the decrypted AETHEL biopiracy dossier to global open-source agriculture networks.
ending.choice_b: Seal the dossier and hand exclusive encrypted custody to the local indigenous elders' collective.
ending.season2_hook: CANOPY-7 alerts you to satellite bio-prospecting sweeps active along the Kannur-Kasaragod coastal belt, launched by parent firm VALENCE GLOBAL.

interview_prompts: Ask the Sulthan Bathery shopkeeper if non-local soil research teams have offered cash for dirt samples.
Ask the Edakkal homestay manager if foreign agronomists mapped private rock faces.
Ask the Ambalavayal co-op member about corporate buyers seeking exclusive heirloom seeds.
Ask the Kolagappara host about strange radio equipment installed on private hilltops.
Ask the Pulpally nursery owner if corporate agents sought exclusive rights to wild plant stocks.
Ask the tea estate supervisor about oral histories of ancient mountain trade routes.
verification_checklist: Confirm private host permissions and Wi-Fi node power supply at all 6 host locations.
Verify GPS coordinates on the ground for accurate player proximity triggers.
Check safety fencing and path conditions along the Ch 6 Lakkidi estate trail.
Ensure Adivasi storyline representations are reviewed and approved by community representatives.
